page.customerSubtitle: Your support requests and disputes with XePrime.
page.tenantSubtitle: Support and disputes about your shop's trips.
page.platformSubtitle: Marketplace-wide queue - highest priority first. Resolving a dispute unlocks settling its booking hold.
page.noPermission: You need the permission below to view the shop's support requests.

form.title: Open a support request
form.subject: Subject
form.descriptionRequired: Description must be at least 10 characters.
form.bookingIdHint: Find it on the trip detail page.
form.bookingRequired: A dispute must reference a trip.
form.disputeHint: A dispute HOLDS the settlement of that trip's booking hold until it is resolved.

detail.title: Request detail
detail.pickOne: Pick a request to see its detail.
detail.closedNotice: This request is closed. Open a new request to continue the conversation.
detail.internalNote: Internal note (customer and shop cannot see it)
detail.resolveHint: The person who opened the request reads exactly this. For disputes, the booking hold can only be settled after this step.

verdict.title: Trip verdict
verdict.hint: Call the owner and the customer to verify, then pick what happened. The booking moves to the matching status and the booking hold settles under the usual rules.
verdict.optionalHint: Dispute before pickup: if the trip did not go ahead as booked, close it with a verdict below. If both sides agreed to keep the trip, resolve the case as usual.
verdict.notePlaceholder: e.g. called the owner and the customer at 10:15, vehicle handed over at 9:00
verdict.noteRequired: Record how it was verified (at least 5 characters).
verdict.audience: This goes into the case conclusion, which the owner can read.

summary.handed_over: Creates the pickup handover at the booked pickup time. The booking moves to Active, and tax and insurance start as if the owner had confirmed.
summary.customer_no_show: The booking moves to No-show and the vehicle schedule is released. The hold settles as a late cancellation: the owner gets the deposit share, insurance is refunded to the customer.
summary.host_not_delivered: The booking is cancelled, the vehicle schedule is released and the customer gets a 100% refund of the hold. The cancellation counts against the owner.
summary.returned: Creates the return handover at the booked return time. The booking completes and the hold is settled.
summary.platform_cancelled: The booking is cancelled, the vehicle schedule is released and the customer gets a 100% refund of the hold. The cancellation does not count against the owner.

money.loadError: Could not load the amounts. The hold still settles under the usual rules.
money.later: This verdict settles no money now: the hold settles when the trip ends.
money.noHold: The booking has no paid hold waiting to settle.
money.deferred: Another dispute is still open on this booking, so the money waits for manual settlement on the Finance screen.

verdict.revertsHandover: The owner already confirmed the handover: this verdict removes the handover record and reverses the trip tax before closing the booking.
verdict.keepsActive: The owner already confirmed the handover: this verdict keeps the trip running.
verdict.insuranceIssued: The insurance certificate has been issued: the customer is still refunded the insurance, and XePrime bears the premium owed to the insurer - tell the insurance team to follow up with the insurer.
